timeline: Present-day Foundation Phase review with reconstruction of the established 9 July 2026 Singapore event
course_reference: Koware Group / Buzzjuice Network / Buzzjuice Courses introduction
humour: light observational humour with one principal slapstick beat
narrative_question: What if the strange event recorded in the archive is only the beginning of a much larger pattern?
beginning_state: The host/producer is reviewing an old anomaly record without a complete explanation.
conflict: The archive appears to contain evidence that does not fully behave like a static historical record.

partial_resolution: Enka survives, reaches another location, and chooses investigation over panic.
ending_hook: A new pulse appears in the archive after the historical event has already ended.
course_function: Introduce Buzzjuice/Koware as the real-world learning ecosystem that the Foundation Phase will explore; do not teach registration/orientation yet.
news_function: Use verified contemporary education/AI/safety headlines as thematic mirrors, never as fictional events caused or solved by Cu.
production_note: Narration length must match the 200-second target. At approximately 145–160 spoken words per minute, target roughly 480–530 spoken words, not 2,400–2,600.
